subject: How do you call NUTS classic?

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: How do you call NUTS classic?
parts:
I do not see how to do it in the doc or command.hpp for CmdStan. Also, it seems to be not known to the binary when you do help-all

  engine=<list element>
    Engine for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
    Valid values: static, nuts
    Defaults to nuts


Ben
